task: [.github/workflows/research-learner.yml] `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` iş akışındaki 62 saniyelik medyan çalışma süresini düşürmek için; pip ve apt bağımlılıklarına `actions/cache` eklenerek yinelemeli paket indirme süreleri optimize edilmeli, dokümantasyon veya ilgisiz kod değişikliklerinde gereksiz tetiklemeleri önlemek adına trigger yapısına `paths` filtresi eklenmeli ve birbiriyle bağımlılığı bulunmayan test adımları ayrı paralel job'lara bölünerek toplam yürütme süresi kısaltılmalıdır.

evidence.finding: The workflow file `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` has a median execution time of 62 seconds due to sequential execution of steps, lack of caching for pip and apt dependencies, and missing path filters on triggers.

factual_findings: Workflow `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` currently triggers on all events without `paths` or `paths-ignore` filtering, causing unnecessary runs for documentation and unrelated file changes.
Pip and apt packages are downloaded repeatedly during each execution of `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` due to missing `actions/cache` configurations.
Independent test and verification steps are executing sequentially in a single job rather than concurrently across parallel jobs in `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml`.
hypotheses: Integrating `actions/cache` for pip (`~/.cache/pip`) and apt package caches (`/var/cache/apt/archives`) will significantly reduce dependency installation overhead across repeated workflow runs.
Adding `paths` filtering to trigger rules in `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` will prevent unneeded workflow triggers on documentation or non-functional modifications.
Decomposing independent workflow steps into separate parallel jobs will decrease total wall-clock execution time well below the 62-second median baseline.
result.recommendation: Refactor `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` to include: 1) trigger `paths` filters (or `paths-ignore` for `**.md` and docs), 2) `actions/cache` steps for pip and apt package directories, and 3) multi-job architecture where non-dependent test/lint steps execute in parallel.
result.next_action: Apply the proposed changes to `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` (path filters, pip/apt caching, job parallelization) and measure workflow runtime improvements.
